[i]The Foreign Office of the New Balion Empire decided to send three different diplomatic teams to each of the three nations. For Ostarev, Count Boniface of Gelham is in-charge of the delegation which will arrive to Ostarev's capital by private plane. For Toqastan, Lord Chelhum who is already in the region for prexisting hostage negotiations which had successfully ended will travel by convey towards the nearest border checkpoint in order to meet with local officials before heading off back to the Empire. And finally for Qarestan, Sir B.J will arrive by ship to the largest port to discuss relations and as well to discuss the capture of a rogue Balionic prison ship which had revolted against prison guards and seamen.[/i]

In the Name of the Merciful,

Jaysh al-Imara al-Shymariyya, slaves of God, may your struggle and the blood spilt throughout it, spring forth a righteous victory. I am in a position of strength within my nation, which will allow for more to commit to your just cause, a number of arms and armaments. Planes bearing the Iroccoan falcon will land, and they will pass normally, and within their cargo holds will be arms to serve your righteousness. Seize the plane, or make contact with the crew. The choice is yours, kill no Iroccoan, and I will convince my Master to recognise you. Succeed and be Loved, fail and be Disgraced. 

Peace be upon those who stand up for the Just,

- ⓿
